newsitem.title: USA: Brooklyn Union unit buys heating co.
newsitem.headline: Brooklyn Union unit buys heating co.

text.p: Brooklyn Union Gas Co said Tuesday that its subsidiary, KeySpan Energy Management, has acquired R.D. Mortman & Co Inc, a heating and maintenance company in New York City.
"The acquisition of R.D. Mortman enhances our ability to provide one-stop energy services in KeySpan's thermal and maintenance lines of business," KeySpan President Gene Martin said in a statement.
Mortman provides 24-hour, seven days-a-week burner service and maintenance, and has expertise in burner and boiler installation.

KeySpan provides a range of energy services to commercial and industrial facilities throughout the New York metropolitan area, including project financing, operations and maintenance, turnkey energy systems, and fuel management.
